name: Yomiuriland
description: Yomiuriland is an amusement park in Inagi, Tokyo and Tama-ku, Kawasaki, Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan that first opened on 19 March 1964.  It is situated on hillsides, and features rides such as roller coasters and water flumes.
reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
parking: Paid public parking options available nearby.
notes: A top recommended attraction in Tokyo, offering excellent photo opportunities and local cultural experiences.
